subtitle: Larger, more readable UI for local split-screen.
description: Scales up Stranded Deep's small interface, including local split-screen, so the HUD, inventory, crafting and prompts remain readable on a divided screen.
features: Scales the interface for both local split-screen players.
Improves readability of HUD elements, text, icons and interaction prompts.
Applies to inventory, crafting and quick crafting UI.
Does not require lowering the game resolution just to make the interface larger.
The selected scale is owned and stored by UI Scaler itself.
An in-game scale slider is available through Mod Settings.
The tested Mod Settings integration presents 100–200% for an internal 1.0–2.0 scale range.

faq.question: What is the main use case?
faq.answer: Local split-screen, where the vanilla UI for each player becomes significantly smaller.

faq.question: Which UI areas are affected?
faq.answer: HUD, interaction prompts, inventory, crafting, quick crafting, interface text and icons.

faq.question: Do I need to lower the screen resolution?
faq.answer: No. The mod addresses readability through UI scale rather than game resolution.

faq.question: Can the scale be changed in-game?
faq.answer: Yes. With Mod Settings installed, UI Scaler exposes an in-game slider.

faq.question: Which mod owns the scale value?
faq.answer: UI Scaler itself. Mod Settings only renders the control and calls the client's getter/setter.
